description: Smoke scenarios the Test-McpEndpoint.ps1 runner executes against the .NET MCP transport. Each scenario names the MCP tool, declares the default argument bag, and (for preview tools) the structural diff field that must come back clean. The baseline tool inventory mirrors the canonical Stage 4 inventory in src/OnToPilot/Mcp/OnToPilotMcpTools.cs:88-142 and migration/baseline/mcp-tools-python.json; if the .NET backend adds or removes a tool the runner fails (or, without -FailOnUnapproved, records the drift in migration/actual/mcp-smoke-report.json).

scenarios.name: discover-tools-list
scenarios.notes: JSON-RPC meta-method invocation. The runner bypasses the tools/call wrapping and calls tools/list directly so the server-side inventory check has parity with baselineToolNames. The scenario must NEVER be invoked via tools/call.

scenarios.name: read-get-ontology
scenarios.notes: Read the TBox for the seeded knowledge system. Per the real schema (OnToPilotMcpTools.cs:108), get_ontology takes no arguments. The runner never logs the response body; only the success/failure shape reaches the report.

scenarios.name: search-ontology-pump
scenarios.notes: Read-side TBox search. Per the real schema, search_ontology requires a 'query' string. Confirms the search tool accepts the default argument bag without surfacing an MCP error envelope.

scenarios.name: list-releases
scenarios.notes: Read-side release inventory. Per the real schema, list_releases takes no arguments. Confirms the read-only release endpoint is reachable.

scenarios.name: preview-ontology-changes-clean
scenarios.notes: preview_ontology_changes must surface added_triples=0 when the empty operations array is previewed against the live ontology. The result schema (OnToPilotMcpTools.cs:587-592) returns added_triples / removed_triples / operation_count scalars — not the unapproved_diff array the previous (rejected) contract claimed. Any non-zero value here is treated as an unapproved difference.
